lib/output/look: `studio look` renders frames through a render session and reads the project's timeline as a render loads it.
lib/output/review: A review artifact names the render snapshot it was made from.
lib/output/sound-check: `studio mix` loads video.tsx in Node through the render's tsx hooks.
lib/output/stills: The still sheet lays out the stills a render produced.
lib/picture/brush-fidelity: The WebGPU painter runs in a headless page through withBrowserModulePage, to paint what the sheet scores.
lib/picture/reel: recap.test loads the reel's studio code in Node through the render's tsx hooks.
lib/picture/stamp-reference: The GPU stages it is held to run in a headless page through withBrowserModulePage.
